name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid-chest, then press it back up.
Use a spotter or safety bars when you go heavy.

name: Incline Barbell Press
steps: Set the bench to a low incline and lie back under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and lift the bar off the rack.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench and hook your legs under the pads.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and lift the bar off the rack.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows close to your sides.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.

name: Wide Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar wider than usual, but never so wide it hurts your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest, then press it back up.

name: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest, hands close.
Bend your elbows a little and lower the bar back behind your head.
Stop at a stretch, then pull the bar back over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell resting on each thigh.
Lie back and hold the dumbbells at your chest, palms facing your feet.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set a low incline and sit with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back and hold the dumbbells at your upper chest.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your chest.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench, legs hooked, dumbbells held at your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your lower chest.

name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
With your elbows slightly bent, open your arms out wide.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a low incline bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and open your arms out wide.
Lower until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a decline bench, legs hooked, dumbbells above your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and open your arms out wide.
Lower until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie on a flat bench, holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your arms almost straight and lower the dumbbell back behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch, then pull it back over your chest.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell at the side of your chest.
Press it up until your arm is straight, keeping your hips flat.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Neutral Grip Dumbbell Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells at your chest, palms facing each other.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly, keeping your elbows close to your sides.

name: Incline Neutral Grip Dumbbell Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells at your chest, palms facing in.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your chest.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Squeeze them hard against each other the whole time.
Lower them to your chest, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells held above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press them back up until your arms are straight.

name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press
steps: Load equal plates on each side and set the seat to chest height.
Press both handles forward until your arms are straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles start near your upper chest.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Decline Machine Chest Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles start near your lower chest.
Press the handles down and forward until your arms are straight.
Let them come back slowly.

name: Pec Deck Fly
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit at chest height.
Hold the handles with your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Incline Machine Fly
steps: Sit back on the incline seat and hold the handles, elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles up and together over your upper chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Set a flat bench so the bar comes down to your mid-chest.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and twist the bar off the hooks.
Lower the bar to your chest, then press it back up.
Twist the bar back onto the hooks when you finish.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
steps: Set an incline bench so the bar comes down to your upper chest.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and twist the bar off the hooks.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up.

name: Smith Machine Decline Press
steps: Set a decline bench so the bar comes down to your lower chest.
Hook your legs, grip slightly wider than your shoulders, and unhook the bar.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, then press it back up.

name: Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys high and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward, lean in slightly, and keep your elbows a little bent.
Pull the handles down and together in front of your chest.
Let your arms open slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with your elbows a little bent.
Sweep the handles up and together at chest height.
Lower them slowly back down.

name: Incline Cable Fly
steps: Place an incline bench between low pulleys and grab a handle in each hand.
Lie back with your arms open wide and elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles up and together over your upper chest.
Lower them slowly back out to the sides.

name: Flat Bench Cable Fly
steps: Place a flat bench between low pulleys and grab a handle in each hand.
Lie back with your arms open wide and elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together over your chest, then lower them slowly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
steps: Set a pulley at chest height and stand with your side to it.
Hold the handle in your near hand, elbow slightly bent.
Sweep the handle across in front of your chest.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Set both pulleys at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with one foot ahead, hands beside your chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Bring them back slowly to your chest.

name: Svend Press
steps: Stand tall and squeeze two plates together between your palms at your chest.
Press the plates straight out in front until your arms are straight.
Keep squeezing as you bring them back to your chest.

name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Kneel with hands under your shoulders, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Put your hands on a bench or wall, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward your hands, then push back up.

name: Push-Up
steps: Start on your hands and toes, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest near the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Decline Push-Up
steps: Put your feet up on a bench and your hands on the floor.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest near the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Archer Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up with your hands set very wide.
Lower toward one hand, keeping the other arm nearly straight.
Push back up, then lower toward the other side.

name: Diamond Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up with your hands together, fingers forming a diamond.
Lower your chest to your hands, elbows close to your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Close Grip Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up with your hands under your chest, close together.
Lower down, keeping your elbows tight to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Wide Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up with your hands much wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest near the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Weighted Push-Up
steps: Wear a weight vest, or have someone place a plate on your upper back.
Keep your body straight and lower your chest near the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Deficit Push-Up
steps: Grip two push-up handles or stacked plates, set shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest below your hands, keeping your body straight.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Clap Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up and lower your chest near the floor.
Push up hard so your hands leave the floor, and clap once.
Land with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up with your body straight.
As you lower, bring one knee out to touch the elbow on that side.
Push back up and return the leg, then switch sides.

name: Hindu Push-Up
steps: Start with hips high and arms straight, your body making an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward, close to the floor.
Straighten your arms to lift your chest, hips low, looking ahead.
Push your hips back up into the V to finish the rep.

name: Pike Push-Up
steps: Start in a push-up, then walk your feet in so your hips point up.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Handstand Push-Up
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting against a wall.
Lower slowly until your head lightly touches a folded mat.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Chest Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up on straight arms.
Lean forward slightly and lower until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Triceps Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up on straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close as you lower.
Stop when your upper arms are level with the floor, then push up.

name: Assisted Dip
steps: Pick the help weight on the stack; more weight makes it easier.
Kneel on the pad and grip the dip handles with straight arms.
Lower until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Weighted Dip
steps: Hang a plate or dumbbell from a dip belt around your hips.
Grip the bars and lower until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Bench Dip
steps: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and legs out.
Slide off and bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor.
Stop when your elbows reach about a right angle, then push back up.

name: Seated Dip Machine
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let them rise slowly until your elbows bend to a right angle.

name: Overhead Press
steps: Stand with the bar resting on your upper chest, hands just outside your shoulders.
Tighten your stomach and press the bar straight up overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your upper chest.

name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on an upright bench and take the bar off the rack.
Lower it to your upper chest, then press it straight up.
Keep your back against the pad the whole time.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on an upright bench with dumbbells at your shoulders, palms forward.
Press them up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Tighten your stomach and press them straight up overhead.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at shoulder height, other hand on your hip.
Press it straight up without leaning to the side.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit with dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up, turning your palms to face forward as you go.
Turn them back as you lower to the start.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set an upright bench so the bar lowers just in front of your face.
Grip just outside your shoulders and twist the bar off the hooks.
Lower the bar to chin height, then press it back up.

name: Landmine Press
steps: Wedge one end of a barbell in a corner and load the other end.
Hold the loaded end at your shoulder with one hand.
Press it up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Push Press
steps: Stand with the bar on your upper chest, hands just outside your shoulders.
Bend your knees slightly, then drive up hard through your legs.
Use that push to press the bar straight overhead.
Lower the bar back to your upper chest with control.

name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
With elbows slightly bent, raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on the end of a bench, back straight, dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and grip a post with the other.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand between two low pulleys, holding each handle in the opposite hand.
Raise both arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back down.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Set a pulley low and stand side-on, holding the handle in your far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Press your arms against the pads and raise them to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back down.

name: Cable Y-Raise
steps: Stand between two low pulleys, holding each handle in the opposite hand.
Raise your arms up and out into a wide Y above your head.
Lower them slowly back down.

name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar up close to your body, elbows leading the way.
Stop at chest height, then lower it slowly.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up close to your body, elbows leading the way.
Stop at chest height, then lower them slowly.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and grip a post with the other.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body, elbow leading, to chest height.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Hold a straight bar on a low pulley in front of your thighs.
Pull the bar up close to your body, elbows leading the way.
Stop at chest height, then lower it slowly.

name: Smith Machine Upright Row
steps: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it about shoulder-width apart.
Twist it off the hooks and pull it up, elbows leading the way.
Stop at chest height, then lower it slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Raise them straight out in front to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly. You can also alternate arms.

name: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart.
Raise it straight out in front to shoulder height, arms nearly straight.
Lower it slowly without swinging.

name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides, arms down.
Raise the plate straight out in front up to eye level.
Lower it slowly back down.

name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley with a rope running between your legs.
Raise your hands straight out in front up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back down.

name: Single-Arm Cable Front Raise
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in one hand.
Raise your arm straight out in front up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope on a pulley at face height and hold both ends.
Step back and pull the rope toward your face, elbows high.
Spread the rope ends beside your ears, then return slowly.

name: Rear Delt Fly
steps: Bend forward at the hips, back flat, dumbbells hanging below your chest.
Rest your forehead on a bench if it helps you keep still.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Rear Delt Fly
steps: Sit on the end of a bench and lean forward, chest near your knees.
Hold dumbbells below your legs, palms facing each other.
Raise your arms out to the sides, then lower slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
steps: Lie face down on a flat or low incline bench, dumbbells hanging down.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit facing the pad, chest against it, handles set in front of you.
Grip the handles at shoulder height with nearly straight arms.
Push your arms back and out until they line up with your body.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and stand in the middle.
Cross your arms and hold each cable in the opposite hand.
Pull your arms back and out until they line up with your body.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Single-Arm Cable Reverse Fly
steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and stand with your side to it.
Hold the handle with your far hand, arm straight across your chest.
Pull your arm back and out to the side, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Bent-Over Cable Rear Delt Raise
steps: Set a pulley low and hold the handle with your far hand.
Bend forward at the hips with your back flat and knees soft.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Seated Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Sit on a bench between two low pulleys and lean your chest forward.
Hold each handle in the opposite hand, cables crossing in front of your legs.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back down.
